title: Spoon Developmental Benchmark Catalog
purpose: Track whether Spoon acquires durable, reusable behavior rather than producing isolated correct answers.

suites.title: Foundations
suites.purpose: Verify execution, contracts, traces, evaluation, and episode recording.

suites.title: Language, Context, and Ambiguity
suites.purpose: Test paraphrase interpretation, contextual reference, and appropriate clarification.

suites.title: Learning and Composition
suites.purpose: Test novel procedure acquisition and composition from reusable procedures.

suites.title: Procedure Selection Under Interference
suites.purpose: Test whether Spoon selects the named capability rather than a merely available distractor procedure.

suites.title: Credit Assignment, Contracts, and Adaptation
suites.purpose: Test local failure attribution, contract refinement, and prevention of repeated failure.

suites.title: Memory, Retroactive Supervision, and Reconciliation
suites.purpose: Test episodic recall, provenance, belief revision, and historical preservation.

suites.title: Transfer, Critics, and Abstraction
suites.purpose: Test reuse of learned structure in held-out domains without direct answer teaching.

suites.title: Normal Conversation
suites.purpose: Test continuity, correction handling, and history-grounded conversation.

suites.title: Teacher Ablation
suites.purpose: Measure whether capability remains when Teacher assistance is removed.

suites.title: Bar Test
suites.purpose: Provide an explicitly human-rated, largely unscripted conversational assessment.
